@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1084] `Langchain::LLM::Response::GoogleGeminiResponse#completion_tokens` includes the thinking tokens (`thoughtsTokenCount`), so prompt plus completion tokens match `total_tokens` for thinking models.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1079] `Langchain::DependencyHelper#depends_on` accepts a gem that's in the bundle through another gem's gemspec instead of the `Gemfile`, such as `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` declared by a gem that depends on langchainrb; it raised `LoadError` before.
 - [FEATURE] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1078] Add `Langchain::Vectorsearch::Milvus#update_texts`; with the default `auto_id` schema Milvus gives each updated text a new id, returned under `"data" => "upsertIds"`.
 - [FEATURE] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1074] Add `Langchain::Vectorsearch::Pinecone#remove_texts`.

@@ -40,7 +40,13 @@ def prompt_tokens
     end
 
     def completion_tokens
-      raw_response.dig("usageMetadata", "candidatesTokenCount")
+      usage = raw_response["usageMetadata"]
+      return unless usage
+
+      # Gemini reports the thinking tokens apart from candidatesTokenCount but bills them as output
+      candidates = usage["candidatesTokenCount"]
+      thoughts = usage["thoughtsTokenCount"]
+      (candidates || thoughts) && candidates.to_i + thoughts.to_i
     end
 
     def total_tokens

@@ -125,4 +125,25 @@
       end
     end
   end
+
+  describe "token counts" do
+    it "counts the thinking tokens as completion tokens" do
+      raw = {"usageMetadata" => {"promptTokenCount" => 8, "candidatesTokenCount" => 20, "thoughtsTokenCount" => 150, "totalTokenCount" => 178}}
+      response = described_class.new(raw)
+
+      expect(response.prompt_tokens).to eq(8)
+      expect(response.completion_tokens).to eq(170)
+      expect(response.total_tokens).to eq(178)
+    end
+
+    it "keeps reporting candidatesTokenCount when the model did not think" do
+      raw = {"usageMetadata" => {"promptTokenCount" => 8, "candidatesTokenCount" => 20, "totalTokenCount" => 28}}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).completion_tokens).to eq(20)
+    end
+
+    it "returns nil when the response has no usage" do
+      expect(described_class.new({}).completion_tokens).to be_nil
+    end
+  end
 end
